summary.text: John Cloutier is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives representing Sullivan 6 who is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 1992.

paragraphs.text: John Cloutier was born in Claremont, New Hampshire, graduated from Stevens High School, and earned a B.S. in education from Keene State College in 1979.
His career experience includes working as a security officer with RCB Security and as a substitute teacher with the Claremont, Cornish and Unity school districts.
Cloutier chaired the Public Works and Highways Committee in the 2019-2020 session and was its vice chair in 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
